title: Blurry image -> health_only (radius-8 blur does not trigger reject)

source.transform: PIL ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=8) applied to the full frame, re-encoded as JPEG q85. Deterministic.
source.notes: no genuinely blurry photo exists in the corpus, so this stays a deliberate synthetic degradation of a real capture -- the only remaining synthetic fixture after the 3.1 rebuild.

notes: docs/metrics-plan.md phase 4 task 2, user decision 2026-09-12: the original hypothesis (radius-8 Gaussian blur pushes the view classifier to reject) was wrong -- observed_phase4 below shows health_only at 0.9999998 confidence. Asserting the honest observed outcome rather than regenerating with a stronger blur to force reject, since the user's stated position is that the app does not rely on a reject state for this kind of degraded input. This fixture no longer exercises §14's blurry-image bullet as a reject case; it documents that the shipped view classifier tolerates this blur level and still routes to health_only.

observed_phase4.method: test/support/native_harness.dart directly (not through the permanent Tier B test file, which is written in task 4), INSTAHAM_NATIVE_TESTS=1, Windows host build from build/windows-host/Release/, no cm_per_px supplied for any fixture (see note per fixture).
